title: Rectangular bar
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a rectangular loop. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0). The second line extends from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0594). The third line runs from (0.75, 0.0594) back to (0.0, 0.0594), and the fourth line completes the rectangle by returning to the origin. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.75. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it with the same vector. Extrude the scaled and transformed sketch 0.0109 units along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional rectangular bar. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. Finally, perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The dimensions of the final rectangular bar are 0.75 units in length, 0.059375 units in width, and 0.0109375 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0594) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0594) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0109)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
